name: hwp-easy
description: Read and edit a selected local HWP, saving verified changes to the same file.

interface.shortDescription: Edit your selected HWP in place
interface.longDescription: Read an HWP file accessible to your agent and save verified edits to the same file, with previous bytes retained for recovery. Supports text, paragraphs, supported merged tables, character formatting and body/cell PNG/JPEG pictures. Selected field values, nested-cell text and character formatting, and picture-group moves and crops are also supported. Requires filesystem access and Node.js 22+ in the agent execution environment. The document engine is bundled; no HWP Easy server, account or upload is required. Support depends on document structure; exact external-viewer page layout is not certified.
defaultPrompt: Use $edit-local-hwp to read and edit the HWP file I select, saving it in place.
